claims.statement: The design system is layered and consumed strictly downward: semantic tokens in src/styles/globals.css feed generic shadcn primitives in src/components/ui, which feed the presentational product-composition families in src/components/product, which feed domain/route UI under the Epics 166–174 migration, with Epic 174 as final audit.

Tailwind configuration is CSS-first in Tailwind v4: tailwind.config.ts is deleted, postcss.config.js runs @tailwindcss/postcss + autoprefixer, and an @theme inline block in src/styles/globals.css maps every utility color to HSL CSS variables covering background/card/popover/muted/brand/primary/destructive, financial, status, availability, telegram, and the full chart role set, with light (:root) and dark (.dark) concrete values.

Token changes are gated by src/styles/__tests__/globals-token-contract.test.ts (every required semantic role declared, complete utility-to-variable mapping) and globals-compiled-contrast.test.ts (real PostCSS-compiled output must meet WCAG contrast for light and dark foreground/background pairs), which is why token edits additionally require npm run build.

src/components/ui primitives are domain-agnostic, render semantic-token surfaces only (no hardcoded or light-only palette values), and carry hardened accessibility contracts — restored Radix Select focus return, native localized ≥44×44 close controls, reserved responsive title space, semantic invalid states, named table scrollers, and motion-reduce variants — while preserving every existing export, variant, portal, and compatibility prop.

Product compositions in src/components/product are presentational only — breadcrumbs, actions, context, controls, and state are route-supplied and own no URL/search/debounce/persistence/query/API/store logic — organized into six families (page context, metrics, filters, tables, charts, states), each guarded by its own Story-owned source-contract test; the product root barrel re-exports only page-context, metrics, and filters, with tables/charts/states consumed via their own subtree barrels.

PageHeader renders exactly one logical h1 per page regardless of visual size (non-empty title required), and ContextBar renders its semantic state (fresh/refreshing/stale/partial/unavailable/restricted/overridden/default) as localized text, never conveying state by color alone, with refresh/reset left to route-owned callbacks.

src/components/product/metrics/presentation.ts is the single semantic map layer (availabilityPresentation across 11 AvailabilityState values, financialDirectionClass, comparisonSentimentClass, statusPresentation), and FinancialValue keeps zero, missing, and unavailable distinct — nullish or non-finite input never becomes a fabricated zero, and compact display is only legal for currency/duration and requires a caller-supplied fullValue string so the full value stays accessible without a tooltip.

FilterToolbar's FilterToolbarState is a discriminated prop union where passive states take an optional reset, 'applied' requires appliedSummary + onReset + resetScope, and 'empty' pins resultCount 0 so a filtered-empty result renders differently from globally absent data; reset is caller-owned and focus-deterministic via resetFocusRef.

ResponsiveTable requires an explicit name (caption node or accessibleLabel) and an explicit TableNarrowStrategy (horizontal-scroll/priority-columns/expanded-detail/stacked-detail), never inferred from column index; TableConsumerContract in tables/contracts.ts declares numeric (tabular numerals, full-value access), caller-controlled sorting, selection, and row-action semantics, and the family deliberately has no TanStack Table client-side data-engine dependency.

The charts family imports no Recharts (rejected by its source contract) — domain consumers own series construction and compose inside ChartFrame; terminal data states (loading/empty/unavailable, error requiring recovery) never fabricate a plot or a zero while retained states (rendered/partial/stale) keep evidence visible, and ChartEvidence conveys series meaning through role × marker combinations with localized labels rather than color alone.

PageState is a discriminated prop union in states/contracts.ts where every state requires title, explanation, and a trust statement; passive kinds forbid retained-evidence props, restricted/not-found require an action, filtered-empty requires scope + resetAction, error requires recovery, and retained kinds require a limitation plus retained children — terminal states cannot fabricate retained content or a zero. src/app/not-found.tsx is the single global not-found owner rendering PageState not-found for every unmatched URL.

Every migrated route ships a *-presentation-source-contracts guard that pins the migrated surface: comment-stripped source is checked against self-tested hex and Tailwind-palette regexes, an exact owned-file catalog is pinned (relative-segment filtering before path join, per the 171.8 anchor-safety lesson), and token/story pins prevent regression; the Epic 172 closing wave added guards for finances, monitor, monitoring (with cross-file legend-sync pins), moysklad, orders (dual-root, fbo/integrity excluded), fbo, integrity, and products, while 173.1's settings shell shipped without a guard.

The monitoring console heatmap keeps STATUS and LEGEND synchronized on semantic CSS-var tokens: heatmap-constants.ts mirrors the cell token colors in LEGEND_ITEMS using var(--color-chart-positive/-negative), status tokens, and a color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-chart-positive) 60%, transparent) alpha variant for 'recovered' so it stays distinct from plain success.

Migration program status (snapshot 2026-08-29): Epics 166–172 are closed (172 complete 17/17), Story 173.1 (settings shell and overview) is done opening Epic 173 at 1/13 with NEXT = 173.2, 77 of 94 canonical stories complete, and the recorded Vitest floor is 19,489/0 across 1,229 files.

Epic 172 closing-wave verdicts: 172.10 finances/documents born-clean with caption RTC, download a11y announcements and mutation.reset on format switch; 172.11 monitor migrated 18 palette + 9 hex to tokens with the gauge band stroke read from a color CSS var via the style prop and the weekly chart on the Recharts var() idiom; 172.12 monitoring console synced heatmap STATUS+LEGEND on tokens; 172.13 moysklad 7 palette→tokens; 172.14 orders overview with status-badge token maps preserving SHIPPED's purple as status-pending; 172.15 FBO born-clean with RTC captions and tabular-nums; 172.16 integrity and 172.17 products small palette→token swaps with frozen RU labels.

Story 173.1 delivered a static settings overview plus a shared seven-route settings shell under src/app/(dashboard)/settings/ (backfill, cabinet, expenses, notifications, tariffs, tax, overview) with role-aware restricted/current states, and carries a credentialed non-Owner visual gap to Epic 174.3 (C18).

Design-system changes are validated with the focused suite `npx vitest run src/styles/__tests__ src/components/ui/__tests__ src/components/product` rather than the full run; token edits also require npm run build because the compiled CSS is what the contrast test parses, and primitive changes must keep the four updated consumer modal tests (shared Russian close label «Закрыть») green.
